title: World Cup Records & Firsts
description: Most goals, most titles, fastest strikes — the record books of the World Cup.

questions.q: Which country has won the most World Cup titles?
questions.explain: Brazil have lifted the trophy five times.

questions.q: Who is the all-time top scorer in World Cup history?
questions.explain: Germany's Klose scored 16 goals across four tournaments.

questions.q: Who scored a record 13 goals at a single World Cup (1958)?
questions.explain: France's Just Fontaine scored 13 in one tournament — still a record.

questions.q: Who scored the fastest goal in World Cup history (about 11 seconds)?
questions.explain: Turkey's Hakan Şükür scored after ~11 seconds in 2002.

questions.q: Which player has played the most World Cup matches?
questions.explain: Messi passed Matthäus, reaching 26 World Cup matches in 2022.

questions.q: Who is the only player to win the World Cup three times?
questions.explain: Pelé won in 1958, 1962 and 1970 with Brazil.

questions.q: In which year was the first World Cup held?
questions.explain: The first tournament was held in Uruguay in 1930.

questions.q: How many teams will play at the 2026 World Cup?
questions.explain: 2026 expands the finals to 48 teams for the first time.
